description: This file implements a Python class for interacting with the Mpesa API, including methods for authenticating, checking account balance, and initiating STK push transactions. It is designed for configuring and performing Mpesa operations in a project.

classes.name: MpesaConnector
classes.description: A class for connecting and interacting with Mpesa API, supporting authentication, balance enquiry, and STK push transactions.

methods.name: __init__(self, env="sandbox", app_key=None, app_secret=None, sandbox_url="https://sandbox.safaricom.co.ke", live_url="https://api.safaricom.co.ke")
methods.description: Initializes the MpesaConnector with environment configuration and API credentials, setting up the base URL and performing authentication.

methods.name: authenticate(self)
methods.description: Fetches an access token from Mpesa to authorize subsequent API requests.

methods.name: get_balance(self, initiator=None, security_credential=None, party_a=None, identifier_type=None, remarks=None, queue_timeout_url=None,result_url=None)
methods.description: Queries the account balance of a given till number or account in Mpesa.

methods.name: stk_push(self, business_shortcode=None, passcode=None, amount=None, callback_url=None, reference_code=None, phone_number=None, description=None)
methods.description: Initiates an STK push payment request to a mobile number using Mpesa's API.
